references.text: Judah and his brothers use the expression 'recognize' (הַכֶּר־נָא) when they show Jacob the bloodied robe—the same expression Tamar uses against Judah in 38:25, an ironic reversal.
Tamar asks for Judah's signet ring, cord, and staff as a pledge—the very items she later presents in verse 25 to identify the father of her child.
Judah's response to Tamar's evidence: he acknowledges that she is more righteous than he, because he did not give her his son Shelah.
Tamar is mentioned in Jesus' genealogy as the mother of Perez and Zerah by Judah, underscoring the salvation-historical significance of this event.
Narrative parallel: A father is asked to identify an object to reveal the truth (Joseph's coat versus Judah's items).
